observations: Three photos show a large, dirty, metallic automotive gearbox lying on a dirt ground, surrounded by other parts and a tarp-covered engine.
The gearbox has a cylindrical housing with visible bolts, a yellow sticker or mark on the top, and numerous hoses, wires, and connectors attached.
The unit appears to be a transmission or gearbox assembly, likely for a vehicle, given its size and design.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the gearbox in any photo.
The seller claims it is a 'Direct Belgium Gearbox ford Expedition V8 4WD', but no such text is visible on the item in the photos.
The photos show signs of use and dirt, consistent with a used or salvaged part.
The watermark 'POSTED ON JI GEARUP INC.' is present on all photos, indicating a reseller or platform.
